minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 12, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, March 12, 2020,
at 2:02 pm in the Community Room “A” 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Dept. (2:12)
  Officer Loren Robinson, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Debra Crenshaw, City Treasures’ Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items
A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
February 27, 2020.

Special Permit Request(s):

Item # 1:  Jakim Stewart DBA Drobes Stogies, to host an Anniversary Party at 1322
  N. LA Brea Ave, on Saturday, March 14, 2020, from 2:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.;
  Inglewood Police Department, Watch Commander will be informed of the
  event and will provide extra patrol; Adequate professional / licensed
  security guards for safety of patrons and employees; obtain Alcoholic
  Beverage Control (ABC) Daily License for the sale and/or service of
  alcoholic beverages; alcohol to be exclusively served / consumed inside
  location establishment only; responsible for ensuring all patrons maintain
  orderly conduct and keep event site clear of littering, loitering and noise
  level should be kept to a minimum; ensure site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all State and Federal Laws and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise
  and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296825)

Item # 2:  Monique Hogan DBA Event Suite, to host a Sweet 16 Party at 8503
  Crenshaw Blvd, on Saturday, March 14, 2020, from 8:00 p.m. – 11:30 p.m.;
  Applicant to hire at least four (4) professional/licensed security guards for
 Permits & License Committee  March 12, 2020
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

  the safety of guests; Security and applicant shall ensure ZERO usage of
  alcohol consumption, marijuana use or smoking of any kind (including
  vaping); the event is to be exclusively inside the location; NO loitering
  outside the location and No use of public streets, sidewalks or alleys;
  Proper / responsible adult supervision is required for this event; Event is
  subject to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer;
  Applicant and/or DJ must comply with all Inglewood Municipal Code Noise
  Standards (IMC 5-27); No loud music from the location past 10pm, per the
  IMC.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all State, Federal and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296971)

Item #3:  Linda Silba, Libraries DBA City of Inglewood, to host Cesar Chavez
  Celebration in Inglewood at – 101 W Manchester, on Tuesday, March 17,
  2020, from 4:30 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.; Watch Commander will be notified and
  extra patrol as time permits; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00296962)

Item # 4:  Angela Williams DBA City of Inglewood, to host E- Waste at One W
  Manchester, on Saturday, March 28, 2020, Saturday June 20, 2020 and
  Saturday June 20, 2020 from 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.; Four (4) TCO's needed
  for street closures; Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol
  provided as time permits; Staff responsible for crowd control and event
  clean up; Applicant to ensure proper notification / requests to public works
  for barricades and Adhere to all State, Federal and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296876)

Item #5:  Terrina Scott DBA Center of Hope to host Alive In Inglewood Easter
  Festival 2020 in Inglewood at – 9550 S. Crenshaw, on Sunday, April 12,
  2020, from 9:30 a.m. –4:00 p.m. Item pulled due to missing property
  agreement for the Forum. (Activity No. 00295852)

Item #6:  Damon Haley DBA Sol Beauty Group to host Mother’s Day Celebration in
  Inglewood at 933 N. LA Brea, Monday May 11, 2020, from10:00 a.m.– 6:00
  p.m.; Approved for one day event within commercial parking lot; Applicant
  to hire adequate professional / licensed security for the safety of patrons,
  crowd control and event clean up; applicant to obtain permission from
  property management / neighboring tenants for use of sidewalk outside /
  and use of multiple parking spots for tents and Adhere to all local, state and
  federal laws. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00296546)
 Permits & License Committee  March 12, 2020
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

New Business Application Request(s):

Item #7:  Alexander Tava of Champion Cutz LLC. DBA Champion Cutz LLC to
  operate a Barbershop at 10306 S. Prairie Ave. (Activity No. 00296837)
  Business owner must possess and maintain valid and current
  Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology;
  Cosmetologist’s, Barbers, Esthetician’s and Manicurists operating within
  the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist’s, Barbers, Esthetician’s and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment is required to register and
  file business tax with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and
  current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic
  beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted
  on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted;
  Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or
  any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; and adhere to all
  State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  #00296837)

Item #8:  William A. Nelson of Century Villa Inc. DBA Century Villa Inc. to operate a
  Skilled Nursing Facility at 301 N. Centinela Ave; Applicant must have
  accurate employment records on all employees at all times; Not to exceed
  six (6) tenants/patients without a city approved Special Use Permit.
  Business owner and/or facility is subject to random inspection by any city,
  county, or state Police and/or Code Enforcement officers during hours of
  operation to ensure patient(s) good welfare, health and safety; Business
  owner/employer is responsible for maintaining accurate and updated
  employee records for all employee’s; Business owner/facility is strictly
  prohibited from hiring or employing any person registered under California
  Penal Code Section 290 PC or any person that may pose a public safety
  risk/threat to patients or other employees at the location; and adhere to all
  State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00296714)

Item #9:  Sherif Antoon of United Protective Services. DBA United Protective
  Services Inc. to operate a Security Services at 4431 W. Rosecrans Ave.
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Maintain valid and current
  Private Patrol Operator License from the Department of Consumer Affairs,
  Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Security Guards must be
  licensed with the Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security and
  Investigative Services; Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited from
  hiring or employing any person registered under California Penal
  Code Section 290 PC or any person that may pose a public safety
